description: Four-row, two-column TEM composite headed "HR+CR+973 K" with rotated row labels 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni, 15Mn5Ni; left-hand panels (a,c,e,g) are bright-field, right-hand panels (b,d,f,h) are dark-field recorded from the (010)κ satellite spot. (a) bright-field shows γ matrix grains with dark elongated grain-boundary B2 particles (white arrow, label "B2"), a 1 µm scale bar, and an inset SADP boxed in yellow labelled "ZA[101]" with the 010κ satellite spot circled (inset bar 10 1/nm). (c) bright-field shows banded γ laths, 500 nm bar, with a second "ZA[101]" SADP inset and the same circled 010κ spot. (b) and (d) are 28Mn0Ni dark-field: (b) is a uniform speckled distribution of fine particles (orange dotted arrow labelled "κ", 500 nm); (d) shows coarse, inhomogeneous κ particles decorating deformation bands, with "γ" and dotted "κ" arrow, 500 nm. (e,f) are 28Mn5Ni and (g,h) 15Mn5Ni; (e) and (g) carry both a solid white arrow and broken yellow arrows labelled "B2", (f) a dotted "κ" arrow on fine speckles, and (h) both "B2" and dotted "κ" arrows. All bars 500 nm except (a). The group demonstrates that the 973 K condition retains mixed deformed/recrystallized austenite in all three alloys and contains both κ-carbide and B2 precipitates whose size and homogeneity differ between regions and alloys.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM of 28Mn0Ni: γ grains with dark elongated intergranular B2 particles marked 'B2' by a solid white arrow; 1 µm scale bar. Yellow-boxed inset SADP labelled 'ZA[101]' with the 010κ satellite reflection circled in yellow, inset scale bar 10 1/nm.
Dark-field TEM of 28Mn0Ni (28Mn0Ni row): dense fine speckled particles uniformly distributed; orange dotted arrow labelled 'κ'; 500 nm scale bar.

Bright-field TEM of 28Mn0Ni: banded/lath-like γ grains (label 'γ') with dark deformation bands; 500 nm scale bar; yellow-boxed inset SADP labelled 'ZA[101]' with circled 010κ satellite spot and 10 1/nm bar.
Dark-field TEM of 28Mn0Ni deformed-austenite region: coarse, inhomogeneous bright κ particles aligned along bands; labels 'γ' and dotted orange arrow 'κ'; 500 nm scale bar.
Bright-field TEM of 28Mn5Ni: dark plate/band structure with B2 particles labelled both by a broken yellow arrow 'B2' (left) and a solid white arrow 'B2' (upper right); 500 nm scale bar.
Dark-field TEM of 28Mn5Ni: fine speckled precipitate contrast with a dotted orange arrow labelled 'κ'; 500 nm scale bar.
Bright-field TEM of 15Mn5Ni: banded structure with a solid white arrow labelled 'B2' (left) and two broken yellow arrows labelled 'B2' (centre); 500 nm scale bar.
Dark-field TEM of 15Mn5Ni: bright particles labelled 'B2' (upper left) and dotted orange arrows labelled 'κ'; 500 nm scale bar.

observations.observation: The figure is a 4-row × 2-column TEM composite headed 'HR+CR+973 K'; row labels read (top to bottom) 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni, 15Mn5Ni, with the left column bright-field and the right column dark-field.
Panel (a) is the only panel with a 1 µm scale bar; all other panels (b–h) carry 500 nm scale bars.
The inset diffraction patterns in (a) and (c) are labelled 'ZA[101]' and contain a circled satellite reflection annotated '010κ', with an inset scale bar of 10 1/nm.
In (b) the dark-field image shows a uniform, fine speckled distribution of particles, annotated with an orange dotted arrow labelled 'κ'.
In (d) the dark-field image shows coarse and inhomogeneously distributed bright κ particles aligned along deformation bands, annotated with a dotted 'κ' arrow and the label 'γ'.
The caption states that dark-field images were captured from the (010) satellite spot shown in the SADP insets.

The caption states intergranular B2 particles are marked with broken (yellow) arrows and intragranular B2 with solid (white) arrows, while the citing text states the reverse (intergranular B2 = solid white arrow, intragranular B2 5–20 nm = broken yellow arrow); the image alone cannot resolve which assignment is correct.

The citing text states the deformed austenite region contained inhomogeneous and relatively coarse κ-carbides of size 10–60 nm, whereas recrystallized regions had fine uniformly distributed intragranular κ-carbides.
The citing text states intragranular B2 particles are 5–20 nm in size and intergranular B2 particles are 50–200 nm in size in the 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni alloys heat treated at 973 K.
The citing text states the size of κ-carbides in deformed austenite regions was higher in the 15Mn5Ni alloy than in the 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni alloys under similar conditions.
The citing text states intergranular B2 particles were observed in the 28Mn0Ni alloy heat treated at 973 K, illustrated in Fig. 6a.
The citing text calls the inset patterns SAED while the caption calls them SADP; both refer to the same indexed [101] zone-axis insets in (a) and (c).

The citing text states that mixed regions of recrystallized and deformed austenite grains were present in all three alloys heat treated at 973 K, consistent with the different precipitate morphologies seen in the paired bright-field/dark-field panels.

unreadable_items: SADP inset index labels other than the circled 010κ spot are only partially readable (a '10 1k'-type reflection adjacent to the circled spot)
Annotation text in panels (e) and (g) is small and overlapping with the microstructure, so the exact arrow-to-feature correspondence for individual B2 particles cannot be confirmed
No numeric size values are printed on any panel; particle-size ranges are only stated in the citing text
